newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ALBANIA, Nov 25 - Durres - Seven vessels discharging of which 1 bagged cement, 1 potatoes, 1 wheat flour, 2 bulk wheat, 1 bagged rice, 1 bulk cement. 1 Vessel loading ferrochrome. 7 Vessels waiting in roads for discharging of which 2 bulk wheat, 2 nitrates, 1 bagged rice, 1 kerosene, 1 phosphate.

BULGARIA, Nov 25 - Varna East - 1 Vessel loading at berth, 1 discharging, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 awaiting orders. West - 4 Loading at berth, 2 discharging, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 bunkering. Lesport - 1 Waiting at anchorage to discharge. Bourgas East - 15 Vessels due, 9 loading at berth, 6 discharging, 14 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 to discharge. 7 Vessels under repairs/drydock. West - 3 Vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging, 2 tankers loading. Bourgas - 54 Operating, 37 loading - 7 ammonia nitrate, 2 fazers, 2 copper, 8 metal, 1 lead, 1 zinc/timber, 1 ammonia sulphate, 5 general, 1 sugar, 3 benzene, 2 gasoil, 4 chemicals. 15 Discharging, 2 sugar, 1 fertiliser, 1 general, 1 tobacco, 1 salt, 1 machinery, 2 coal, 2 petrol, 1 zinc concentrate, 3 containers. 2 Discharging/loading containers. 12 Waiting in roads, 5 to load - 2 steel, 1 gasoil, 1 chemical, 1 general, 2 to discharge cars, sugar, 1 to discharge/load containers, 2 awaiting orders, 2 bunkering, 1 sea trial. 13 Vessels due, 7 to load, 6 to discharge.

Varna - 32 Operating of which 18 loading - 5 soda, 1 timber, 2 scrap, 2 clinker, 1 sas, 2 urea, 1 ntp, 2 quartz sand, 1 cigarettes, 1 kaoline. 6 Discharging, 1 phosphorite, 4 coal, 1 apatite. 5 Discharging/loading containers, 1 discharging/loading urea/soda 2 discharging/loading trucks/containers. 12 In roads, 3 to load, 1 clinker, 1 soda, 1 kaoline. 1 Discharging apatite, 1 discharging/loading containers, 7 cargo not nominated.

CROATIA, Nov 25 - Rijeka - Four vessels discharging at berth, 5 loading, 6 under repair/drydock, 2 berthed inoperative, 1 anchored, 6 due. Delays expected. Sibenik - One vessel due, delays expected, 1 vessel anchored. Ploce - One vessel loading at berth. Pula, Rasa, Zadar, Split, Dubrovnik - No vessels.

CYPRUS, Nov 26 - Limassol - Vessels due, 3 containers, 2 conventional, 4 passenger, 1 cruise. No delays. 7 Container vessels discharging/loading at berth, 1 conventional vessel discharging at berth, 2 ro/ros discharging/loading at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge/load. Larnaca - Vessels due 27/11, 2 containers, 2 conventional. No delays expected. 3 Container vessels discharging/loading at berth, 2 conventional vessels discharging, 1 ro/ro discharging/loading at berth.

ESTONIA, Nov 26 - Tallinn city port - 5 Vessels due, no delays expected, 3 loading at berth of which 1 ferro alloys, 1 map, 1 dap, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 liner vessel. Kopli - 2 Vessels due, 1 discharging meat at berth. Muuga - 3 Due, no delays expected. 6 Loading at berth, 3 oil, 1 timber, 1 fertiliser, 1 scrap. 3 Discharging grain at berth, 2 ferries. Parnu - 6 Due, no delays. 3 Loading at berth, 1 briquettes, 2 peat.

ITALY, Nov 26 - Naples - One container vessel berthed. Gaeta, Salerno - No vessels in roads. Genoa commercial port - No vessels in roads, no delays, 45 vessels berthed, 4 in drydock. Multedo oil harbour - No vessels in roads, no delays, 2 vessels berthed. Savona - No vessels in roads, no delays, 4 vessels berthed. Vado Ligure - One vessel in roads, no delays, 1 berthed. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays. 5 Vessels berthed, 5 under repair/drydock. Leghorn - 11 Vessels in roads, 36 berthed. Civitavecchia - One vessel in roads, no delays. Gaeta, Naples, Salerno, Palermo, Ancona/Falconera - No vessels in roads, no delays. Augusta oil harbour - Two vessels in roads, 2 berthed. Syracuse oil harbour - Two vessels in roads, 1 berthed. Sarroch - Five vessels in roads, 2 berthed. Taranto - One vessel in roads, no delays. Ravenna - Eight vessels in roads. Venice - Three vessels in roads. Trieste - Two vessels in roads.

LATVIA, Nov 26 - Riga - 15 Vessels operating of which 4 timber loaders, 2 container loaders, 1 each cotton loader, fertiliser loader, tanker loader, scrap metal loader, sugar discharger, 2 metal loaders, 2 frozen food dischargers. No delays. 15 Vessels due. Ventspils - Three vessels operating of which 1 steel and steel billets loader, 1 cotton loader, 1 mop loader, no delays, 11 vessels due. Liepaja - Nine vessels in port, 7 operating, 2 waiting, no delays, no vessels due.

LITHUANIA, Nov 25 - Klaipeda - Vessels loading in port 1 pellets, fertiliser, 1 scrap, 1 timber products, 1 steel coils, 1 steel pieces. Discharging, 2 fish, 1 sugar, 1 orimulsion, 1 cars, 2 corn, 2 loading/discharging. 3 In roads, 25 vessels due.

POLAND, Nov 26 - Szczecin - 105 Vessels due, delays expected. 58 Vessels loading at berth, 42 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 7 under repair/drydock, 1 awaiting orders. Gydnia - Eight vessels operating, 1 grain vessel awaiting turn, 4 loading at berth (1 coal, 2 bulk, 1 general cargo). 4 Discharging (2 bulk, 2 general cargo). 5 Under repair/drydock, 48 due. Gdansk - Ten vessels operating, 2 awaiting turn (coal, bulk). 9 Loading at berth of which 1 coal, 5 general cargo, 3 bulk). 1 Discharging grain at berth, 5 under repair/drydock, 17 due.

PORTUGAL, Nov 26 - Sines - Four vessels operating, 1 each discharging reactors, coal, chemical naphtha, 1 loading butane/propane. 3 Waiting to load, 1 propylene, 1 propane, 1 gasoil/gasoline/jet fuel. Vessels due, 2 to discharge metallic structures, 1 to discharge chemical naphtha, 1 to discharge coal, 1 each to load aromatic mixture, fuel oil, metallic structure,thylene, butadene. Setubal - Five vessels loading at berth, 9 discharging at berth, 7 under repair/drydock. Vessels due - 4 To discharge, 3 to load, 2 for repairs/drydock.

ROMANIA, Nov 26 - Constanta - 49 Vessels operating of which 18 generals (16 loading/2 discharging), 16 bulkers (7 loading/9 discharging) 10 bagged chemicals loading, 1 tanker discharging, 2 cement loading, 2 containers loading/discharging). 10 Waiting in roads of which 1 general loading, 7 bulkers (3 loading, 4 discharging), 2 tankers discharging. Constanta south (Agigea) - Two general loading/discharging, 1 bulker discharging. Mangalia - One bulker loading. Midia - Two livestock carriers loading.

RUSSIA, Nov 25 - Baltic Ports, St. Petersburg - 25 Vessels operating of which 19 loading 11 non-ferrous, 1 coal, 2 containers, 4 fertiliser, 1 machinery. 6 Discharging of which frozen meat, 1 bananas, 2 container vessels, 1 milk foods. 6 Waiting operations, 2 due. Nov 26 - Kaliningrad - 11 Vessels operating of which 1 alumina loader, 2 scrap metal loaders, 2 nitre loaders, 1 gravel loader, 1 coke loader, 1 cocoa discharger, 2 grain dischargers. No delays, no vessels due. Vyborg - Seven vessels operating, no delays, 7 due.

Black Sea, Novorossiysk - 12 Vessels operating of which 7 loading, 4 steel, 1 scrap, 1 grain, molasses. 5 Discharging, 1 coal, 1 bagged rice, 1 bulk sugar, 1 general, 1 citrus. 7 Waiting in roads, 1 to load scrap, 6 to discharge, 1 bagged rice, 1 bulk sugar, 4 citrus. 27 Due of which 16 to load, 3 scrap, 9 steel, 1 copper, 1 urea, 1 paper/steel, 1 grain. 11 To discharge, 1 rice, 5 citrus, 4 luggage, 1 general. Oil terminal - 2 Vessels loading crude, 4 waiting in roads to load crude, 12 due to load of which 8 crude, 1 diesel oil, 3 fuel oil.

Far East, Vladivostok - Ten vessels in port of which 2 passenger vessels, 4 vessels loading (3 metal, 1 timber), 4 waiting. Nakhodka - Ten vessels in port of which 7 loading (2 metal, 2 aluminium, 2 timber, 1 cotton), 3 waiting. Vostochniy - Eight vessels in port of which 7 loading (1 coal, 2 timber, 2 container vessels, 2 metal), 1 waiting. Posyet - No vessels. Zarubino (formerly Khasan) - One vessel loading metal. No delays, no congestion.

Northern Basin, Murmansk - Five vessels operating of which 1 alumina, 1 npk, 1 apatite, 2 cabotage. No berthing delays. 6 Vessels due during the week of which 3 loaders (2 apatite, 1 coal), 3 dischargers (2 alumina, 1 cabotage).

SLOVENIA, Nov 25 - Koper - Ten vessels berthed of which 2 containers loading/discharging. 2 bulk carriers to discharge coal, phosphates, 1 bulk carrier loading corn. 2 car carriers to load cars, 1 livestock vessel loading bullocks, 1 general cargo to load steel profiles, paper. 1 tanker to discharge gasoline, 11 vessels due during next 2 days of which 3 car carriers to load and discharge cars, 2 bulkers discharging chrome ore, phosphates, 1 bulker loading coal, 2 livestock loading, 2 container vessels loading/discharging, 1 reefer discharging fruit. No delays expected.

SPAIN, Nov 26 - Aviles - Seven vessels in port of which 4 discharging (2 fertiliser, 1 steel coils, 1 alumina). 3 loading (1 sulphur, 1 steel products, 1 ammonium nitrate). Gijon - Eight in port of which 2 discharging (1 coke, 1 iron ore). 6 loading (1 cement, 1 wire rods, 1 special cargo, 1 sugar, 1 general cargo, 1 fertiliser). Stevedore strike continues with stoppages at odd hours. Cadiz - 14 vessels operating of which 4 ro/ro, 1 clay, 1 salt, 1 wood, 1 sand, 1 semolina, 1 wheat. 4 under repairs, no delays. Pasajes - 18 vessels in port of which 8 discharging scrap, 1 discharging general cargo, 1 discharging steel, 2 discharging fertiliser, 1 discharging woodpulp, 1 discharging granite, 2 discharging/loading cars, 2 loading steel, no delays. Holiday 6/12, Constitution Day.

TURKEY, Nov 26 - Mersin - Sixteen vessels awaiting orders. 22 vessels operating of which loading, 1 flour, 1 citrus, 1 general cargo, 3 cement, 1 legumes/cargo/containers, 2 chrome ore, 1 livestock, 2 pumice stones, 1 pipes, 1 container vessel, 1 soda, 1 legumes. Discharging, 1 wheat, 1 iron, 1 chemicals, 1 wheat flour. 2 Container vessels discharging/loading. Free zone piers, 1 vessel discharging rice, 2 discharging sugar. Seka - One vessel discharging fertiliser. Istanbul - Haydarpasa - 8 Vessels operating of which 2 containers, 2 dry cargo, 2 ro/ro. Galata - 9 cargo/passenger vessels operating. Ambarli - 14 operating, no berthing delays. Iskenderun - Three discharging of which 1 steel billets, 1 timber, 1 motor. 1 Citrus loading.

Sariseki - One vessel discharging phosphate, 1 loading anthracite. Yazicilar - Two discharging scrap, 1 loading cement, 1 anchored. Ekinciler - One scrap iron discharging. Isdemir - one discharging fuel oil, 1 loading steel billets. Mersin - 24 vessels operating of which loading, 1 flour, 1 general cargo, 1 citrus, 2 chrome, 1 cotton, 1 beans, 1 clinker, 1 pipes, 1 cement, 2 soda, 1 pulses, 1 pumice, 2 containers. Discharging, 1 wheat, 1 ethyl hexanol, 1 flour, 1 vehicle, 1 sugar, 1 cotton. Import/export 1 vehicle, 1 container vessel, 18 anchored.

UKRAINE, Nov 26 - Mariupol - 10 Vessels loading (fertiliser, sunseed, metals, sulphur, urea, coal). 4 Discharging (sunseed, containers). 3 Waiting at anchorage to load (fertiliser, metal products). 6 Waiting to discharge (5 sunseed, 1 container). 9 Floating storehouses (fertiliser, metal products, sulphur). 2 Under repair/drydock, 21 due (coal, containers, metal products, sunseed, general, ore). Kerch - Four vessels under repair. Berdiansk - Three loading at berth (fertiliser, metal), 2 due (metal). Odessa - Vessels loading, steel cargo 2 alongside, 6 due. Grain cargo loading 2 alongside, 1 anchored, 1 due. Grain discharging 1 due. Tanker loading 2 alongside, 1 anchored. General cargo 2 alongside, 1 anchored, 3 due. Ilyichevsk - Steel loading 6 vessels alongside, 1 anchored. Containers 1 alongside. Fertiliser 1 alongside.
